title_zh: 决定先参加陶艺体验课再考虑正式报名

scenario.label_zh: 询问陶艺课程并选择先参加体验课
scenario.goal_zh: 询问陶艺课程的入门要求，并约好周六参加体验课

context_zh: 英国社区陶艺工作室的前台与首次来访者交谈。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: I would like to enquire about your evening pottery course. Is it suitable for a complete beginner?

sentences.speaker: Stan
sentences.text: Yes, but if you are unsure, you can try the Saturday taster before committing to six weeks.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: Do I need to enrol on the full course to attend the taster?

sentences.speaker: Stan
sentences.text: No. The taster has its own booking list, and tools are provided.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: Then could you put me down for the taster this Saturday?

sentences.speaker: Stan
sentences.text: Certainly. I have reserved a place under Imogen. It starts at eleven.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: Thank you. I will come at eleven and decide about the full course afterwards.
